## About

I am a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the [Centre for the Study of African Economies](https://www.csae.ox.ac.uk/) in the [Department of Economics](https://www.economics.ox.ac.uk/) at the University of Oxford. I completed my PhD in Public Policy at the [School of Public Policy](https://liberalarts.oregonstate.edu/spp), Oregon State University, in 2026. My work sits at the intersection of the economics of education, child labor, climate change, and program evaluation.

You can download my full CV [here](cv/cv.qmd).

**Research interests:** Economics of Education · Child Labor · Climate Change · Program Evaluation · Evidence Synthesis
